### Overview

This Phase 1 abstract interpretation analysis examined **all go-ethereum code paths** relevant to KZG field element range validation (`bytes_to_bls_field` rejecting values >= BLS_MODULUS) across checklist items CHK-0063 through CHK-0070.

### Key Architectural Finding

go-ethereum **does not implement `bytes_to_bls_field` itself**. It delegates all KZG cryptographic operations to two external libraries:
- **go-eth-kzg** (`github.com/crate-crypto/go-eth-kzg`) -- the Go-native backend
- **c-kzg-4844** (`github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/v2`) -- the C-based backend via CGO
